title: Dashboard chart widget empty on first mount (pie & bar): data present, repaints on reload — first screen of every AI-built app
body:
## Symptom (P2, recurring): dashboard chart widget renders EMPTY on first mount — data is fine, a refresh paints it

2026-08-21 live repro on the cloud local rig (objectui `fd227eae1`, console built from workspace): open an AI-built dashboard (`客户管理首页仪表盘`, one pie widget bound to a dataset with 3 categories / 12 rows). First navigation into the dashboard renders the widget card with its title and an EMPTY chart area (no slices, no axes, no empty-state message). Press F5 → the pie renders correctly (3 slices).

The same behavior was observed on 2026-08-13 with a bar widget (no bars on mount, data confirmed present via the data API, recovers on re-render) — so it is not chart-type-specific and has survived at least a week of main.

## Why it matters

This is the FIRST screen an AI-build user sees after publishing ("首页仪表盘按状态统计客户数量" is the standard magic-flow prompt). An empty chart on first open reads as "the AI built a broken app" — it undoes the entire publish pipeline's credibility for the cost of one missed re-render.

## Repro

1. cloud rig `run-stack.sh --with-ui`, build an app via the build agent with a dashboard (pie or bar) bound to a real dataset.
2. Publish; from the launcher open the app → dashboard nav entry.
3. First render: empty chart area. Reload: chart paints.

Suspected class: the chart mounts before its dataset query resolves (or before the container has measured dimensions) and never re-draws when data arrives — race, not data. Not bisected; the fix owner should instrument mount/data-arrival ordering in the dashboard widget renderer.
